title: Managing Members, Invites & Archive Settings
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Check System Diagnostics and Admin Docs
steps.posterAlt: Site Administration showing live System Diagnostics health checks and built-in module documentation.

cues.text: Open Site Administration and check System Diagnostics to confirm database, media storage, and active plugin health.
Built-in Admin Docs and Changelogs give stewards version notes and configuration guidance directly inside the archive.

steps.title: Issue Family Invites and enroll Editors
steps.posterAlt: Site Administration Family Invites panel with revocable read-only links and member role management.

cues.text: Create labeled Family Invite links to share a private archive read-only with relatives, and revoke any link immediately if needed.
Enroll family stewards as Editors or Admins in the Members list to delegate record maintenance safely.

steps.title: Configure Plugin Settings and scoped Agent Tokens
steps.posterAlt: Site Administration Plugin Settings cards and scoped Agent Tokens section.

cues.text: Configure installed Plugin Settings directly in Site Administration without redeploying your worker.
Generate least-privilege Agent Tokens with read_backup or write_batch scopes for offline backups and scripted research.
